info.title: SongRequest local API
info.description: HTTP + WebSocket access to every SongRequest feature and status. Authentication is optional: set a token in Settings > API & MCP and send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. The send-in list and library can be searched with /api/v1/songs and /api/v1/search. Live updates are pushed over /api/v1/ws (WebSocket, JSON messages).
